steps.text: '...The seventh batch of new comms stations has been set up. One-third of all comm lines have been restored.'
'Data from makeshift Catastrophe monitoring stations indicate stabilizing atmospheric Originium concentration, but rising underground Originium activity.
'Two more teams of engineers have arrived at their destination. Continue to eliminate obstacles standing in the way of the main fleet.'
'Four battleships from the Duke of Gododdin, including the Felicis, will arrive at the rendezvous point in fifteen minutes to join the escort flotilla after resupply.'
'Joint Command confirms that Wellington reinforcements—'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You hear those announcements? The ducal alliance's forward base is just ahead.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Smooth sailing so far.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We owe Rhodes Island our thanks for plotting our route. And it's not just us who are indebted to them.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Should we drive our tanks straight in? Small encounters are one thing, but this is one of the main camps of the ducal alliance. Will the Exemplars' ID code really work?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Of course. Please leave trifles like these to me and proceed ahead.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Your entrances are always so sudden, Mister Asher. Looks like you've been keeping an eye on our little procession in the middle of everything else you had to do.

spans.text: Your entrances are always so sudden,
. Looks like you've been keeping an eye on our little procession in the middle of everything else you had to do.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: There's a group of soldiers up ahead, Vina! Plus a few trucks of ammo, gear, and food!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Should we just accept it? Could be a trap this berk's laid for us.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yes... we'll take it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Ideals alone don't win battles.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Thank you, Mr. Bellingham. Sincerely, this time. You've helped us more than once.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Please, don't call me that. I'm perfectly content being the Strange Man in the Hat. It's for the better if you suspect ulterior motives behind my every move.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: These gifts aren't just for Gibsonham. It's also for everything that Rhodes Island has done. We have sent people to direct civilians to the safe zones.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Gifts? Didn't think you engaged in such courtesies.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Better than not doing anything, isn't it? You know how Victoria works. The towns around Londinium were not part of the Duke of Caster's jurisdiction.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Considering the circumstances, however, Her Grace was forced to take certain actions that might perhaps be controversial in the future, in order to provide safe shelters for as many as possible—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enough, I'm not interested in how Duke Caster intends to win people over.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Tell me where the Stone of the Sword is, and what's happening at the front lines.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No need to rush, Your Royal Highness. The history of the Stone of the Sword is long and complex...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Ideally, I would require several dozen photographs, an abundance of literature, and have you cleared for the highest access before I could properly recount these stories.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: In any case, I will take you to the front personally. If I were you, I would tell the troops to get some rest at the camp, while they still can.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You will learn more about the situation at the camp. Seeing is worth a thousand words, is it not?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Here, I'll help!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Heave, ho!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: That's the last crate.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Thank you. We were running short on ammo.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The logistics team says they'll whip up a bonnie meal from the supplies ye brought before we head out. Care tae join us for a bite?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Thanks for the offer, but we've got Sarkaz scums to kill.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: We just received orders from Command to join up with the assault on Silverrock Bluffs once we've transferred the supplies.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Those monsters... Nachzehrers, they're called? I can't wait to put them down!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Look at this. The newest crossbows, AP ammo, precision Arts Units. This stuff would be rare even in elite units in ordinary times.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: What about Originium protection? Fighting Sarkaz isn't just about firepower.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: No worries. We've been issued a full set of PPE, plus medication. Look.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: What the...

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Break's over, Private Brown. Get ready to move.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Have you oiled your crossbow?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I'll oil it with the blood of Sarkaz. Hope their blood doesn't stink too much.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Good man. Now back to your squad.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Are you the commander of this unit? My name's Shearer. I served as the medical officer on the Duke of Windermere's flagship.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Your soldiers claim they've been issued sufficient Originium PPE, but—

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: What are you trying to say, lieutenant? As far as I know, the Duke of Windermere's troops have withdrawn from the war. It's not your place to question me.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Go back to whatever you're supposed to be doing.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: You know full well, don't you?

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: This type of equipment offers protection against mild industrial pollution at best. And yet you're issuing them to soldiers...

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Soldiers who are about to walk into highly active Originium plume, to face a Catastrophe and Infected Sarkaz head-on!

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: They'll all get infected, and die on the front lines from acute symptoms!

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: On what authority are you speaking to me? As a lieutenant of the so-called Exemplars?

spans.text: On what authority are you speaking to me? As a lieutenant of the so-called

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: I'm questioning you as a citizen of Victoria with a medical education, Major.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Victorian citizen, eh...?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Then you should know that not even Victoria could produce specialized Originium PPE for a hundred thousand soldiers on such short notice.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: But you should at least tell them the truth!

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: By observing proper operating procedures in highly active Originium environments, their infection rates could be reduced by as much as—

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Spare me the lecture. We came to fight. We came to die.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: But we will take the Sarkaz with us, until victory belongs to Victoria!

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Infected? Oripathy? There will be no confirmed cases of Oripathy in the Victorian Army before the end of the war.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: This is absurd! You're—

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Me, my commanding officer, and his commanding officer will all be wearing the same protective equipment. We will charge with our men; nay, we'll be leading the charge.

spans.text: commanding officer will all be wearing the same protective equipment. We will charge with our men; nay, we'll be leading the charge.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Now, let go of me.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: If you want to make a difference, Exemplar, go to the front lines.

spans.text: If you want to make a difference,

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Lieutenant Shearer.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: You heard him...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Thanks to advance warning from our Rhodes Island friends, the Exemplars have sufficient protective gear. We even have some to spare—

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: What little we can provide is just a drop in the ocean for the tens of thousands in need.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: All we can do is take care of ourselves. We have our own duty.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: To bring an end to all this, as quickly as we can...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It... can't be?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's him.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Yer shield... why are ye loadin' your weapon, Captain? Whit're ye daein'?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Wait for me!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What did ye see?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Someone I thought to be long dead.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Lieutenant.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What happened to my men?

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: They are here. Rest assured, they're only unconscious.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I don't mean Cello's group.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You know who I mean.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't push me, or it won't be my shield against your chin.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*... If you draw your sword, you'll be assaulting an ally.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Heh. Ally?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: At what point, since the moment we entered County Hillock, have you ever treated us as an ally?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Answer me!!!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: —Lost him.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hill... adjutant to Colonel Hamilton.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I thought he had died in the fires of Dublinn with the Colonel.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Not just him. I saw many familiar faces on the Wellington tanks. They could change their clothes, but I'll never forget their faces.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: County Hillock...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I remember my men, Bagpipe, and how each of them died.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cello and Oboe died at the hands of Dublinn. Triangle, Snare, Bass, and Mandolin died to 'friendly fire'.

spans.text: Cello and Oboe died at the hands of Dublinn. Triangle, Snare, Bass, and Mandolin died to

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Moments before dying, Triangle asked me, 'who is our enemy?'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: There isn't a night when I don't think about that question.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Just who is our enemy, Bagpipe?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's... Dublinn.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Dublinn... Certainly, we could hate the Tarans.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You once told me that you encountered the former 'Leader' of Dublinn, and let her go.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I met our enemy too. The Dublinn commander who killed Cello. I buried her by the walls of Londinium with my own hands.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I couldn't stop myself from hating her, but I know she's far from the only one responsible for this tragedy.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Why did our comrades, the most loyal soldiers of Victoria, die at County Hillock, while Hill and more traitors live?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain, we...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If we fire at the duke's tents now, we risk bringing down the alliance... even the dream of the Exemplars.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's the saddest thing, isn't it?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We can't even take revenge.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Because they've put on their bloody Victorian uniforms, and once again become our 'allies'.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain... permission to speak freely?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Granted.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: ...I don' trust 'em.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Would the men who killed our friends, the ones who fired on innocent civilians, really stand with us when we charge against the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Even we cannae set aside our hatred and trust our lives tae our former enemies wi'oot reservation...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Could they?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There you are.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Vina and I inspected this forward base.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The troops are disciplined, and morale is high. The dukes are taking this seriously.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: They seem to have reached a united front, allowing their troops to be organized according to function rather than faction.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: At least, that's what it looks like on the surface.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We saw Caster's elites standing guard near all the Wellington tents.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: And at least two or three groups of Caster's men stationed further away.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: A faked unity is unity nonetheless.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: At least, in a time of crisis, the dukes know who their true enemy is.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: One more piece of bad news. I checked out the field hospital. It's sparkling clean. There isn't a single wounded inside.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They’re abandoning the wounded? That's impossible. Morale would collapse.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Or maybe there are no wounded.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Also impossible. We saw how fierce the fighting is on our way here. Things could only be worse at Silverrock Bluffs—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Wait, you don't mean...?

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: None of the wounded made it back.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We need to put an end to this tragedy as soon as we can.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Exemplars' strength might be insignificant compared to the all-consuming war, but creating miracles, that's what we do.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: An inspiring pep talk. Repairs on your tanks are complete.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There you are at last.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Wait, why's the ground red? It is your blood? Or...?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: That's not important.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My orders are to ensure that the Sighs of Kings finds its pedestal. Should I fail, another will put on this hat and continue the work.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I bring a message from the Duke of Caster, Your Royal Highness. 'Caster forever honors her commitments.'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enough pleasantries. Where is this pedestal, this Stone of the Sword?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You've seen the camp. You have an idea of what the front is like.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is hardly the best time to tell you the truth, but we have no choice.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The pedestal is on the Gloriana, flagship of the Duke of Caster.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...You planned this all along.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You guided our path, gave us a place to rest, so you could lead us onto your home field.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What's next? Will Caster's troops turn their weapons on us if we say no?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Please, no need to get excited. Facts are facts, no matter how you choose to interpret them.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My orders were always to bring the Realmblade to the Stone of the Sword, with or without Exemplars.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Please, consider it an act of good faith that I am telling you the truth now, rather than simply taking the sword from you during your darkest hour.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Continue.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Like I said, the history around the sword and the pedestal is a complex one. One that ought to be known only by a selected few royals and nobles.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: In the distant past, even before the Shah of Past and Future, an explorer discovered an artifact deep in the sands in the south of Sargon.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It was by no means a sword, but it was able to repress the spread of Originium crystals within a certain area

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The treasure allowed the explorer to survive a Catastrophe that should have engulfed the entire team.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The legend of the Catastrophe cleaver...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The survivors forged a sword out of the artifact and presented it to the Shahanshah at the time, as a symbol of valor.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: In the Year 737, the Aslan Padishah Lugalszamszi brought the Sighs of Kings to Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Decades later, his grandson became Victoria's first Lord of Lions.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The sword has severed the head of a red dragon, witnessed the reconciliation between Aslan and Draco, and became the symbol of Victoria's royal authority.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It has been damaged and reforged several times, and many have tried to uncover the secret behind its ability to fend off Catastrophe.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Scholars have yet to understand the principles behind the sword's power, but they did discover how to make the most of it.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The pedestal, dubbed Stone of the Sword, at the Mausoleum of Kings is the result of research by House Caster.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Duke of Caster at the time kept a backup.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: After the original pedestal in the Mausoleum of Kings was destroyed in that battle, the only working replica is kept on the Gloriana.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: For a century, Caster has coveted the Realmblade. The chance has finally arrived.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Countless soldiers and civilians will die in the war. But Caster gets to reap the fruit of victory and become the hero who saves Victoria?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Judge it as you will, but this is what little chance, if not the only chance at victory Victoria has in the present crisis.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Our trump card in this dangerous game.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sugarcoat it all you want, but you can't convince us that the despicable scheming never happened.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The choice is yours, Your Royal Highness.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I refuse to engage in arguments over power, while we denounce the dukes for being calculative.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There is no Princess Alexandrina, only Siege, leader of the Exemplars.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There is no symbol of royal authority. The Sighs of Kings is just a weapon, one that can win the war for Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We go to war.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Thank you, on behalf of Victoria.
The spy takes half a step back and bows.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'll lead the way. However...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You should prepare yourselves.
'East vanguard reports retaking three villages by Duskglow River. Sarkaz forces continue to staunchly defend Silverrock Bluffs pass.'
'All resistance on the southern front of the Redmane Mountains has been neutralized, however, Command expressly forbids crossing the mountains to flank the Sarkaz.'
'All gunboats and dreadnoughts in position. Support gunboats have also arrived at their destination.'
The ground continues to tremble. The weary travelers can no longer distinguish the quakes from bombardments or the clusters of Originium erupting from the earth.
The earth is scarred by deep, crisscrossing battleship tread marks. The stench of blood and sludge hangs heavily in the air.
The Exemplars' tanks lumber through the rugged terrain.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're almost in the hot zone.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How far until Duke Caster's flagship?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: A moment please. I'm searching for the signal.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Keep heading north, and we'll soon—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Witchcraft guns!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The lead tank has been destroyed! We've taken damage too.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We can't move. Is it the engine or the wheel?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Possibly both.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Fix it ASAP.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We can't stay here. We need to deliver the Realmblade to the Stone of the Sword.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Wait... what's that mountain? I don't recall any mountain like that outside Londinium.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's no mountain...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's Originium.
The churning tides of Originium have coalesced into a colossal mass, blotting out the sun and transforming the very landscape. In its shadow, even battleships appear as mere specks.
Above the mountain of Originium—
A withered throne ominously hovers.
The Nachzehrer King gazes upon the battlefield.
All seeds sprout at the same time, withered branches creeping towards every death shrouded corner.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Go, my bravest warriors.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Gnaw upon the greatest bone. Tear iron and steel apart as you would skin and flesh. Rip, tear, consume.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: We shall teach the Victorians: the master of war—

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Shall master war.
